clues.text: One night at Gibeon, God appeared to this king in a dream and said, "Ask, and I will give it to you!"
Bathsheba bore this son to King David, and the LORD loved the child.
The queen of Sheba heard of this king's fame and came to test him with difficult questions.
This king of Israel composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
When this king of Israel grew old, his many foreign wives turned his heart after other gods.
This king built the house of the LORD on Mount Moriah, at Ornan the Jebusite's threshing floor.
Jesus said that not even this king in all his glory was dressed like the lilies.
